observation_unit: one fictional volunteer in a single cross-sectional survey
outcome: belonging_score, a fictional self-report score from 0 to 100
exposures: long_commute, 1 if a fictional commute is at least 45 minutes
target: conditional association of one additional reported study hour with mean belonging score among comparable fictional volunteers at the same long_commute value
design_limit: neither an effect of changing hours nor a representative student-population association
preprocessing: x=study_hours_per_week - 5; z=long_commute; no row exclusion or imputation
familiar_route: unadjusted OLS y~1+x and adjusted OLS y~1+x+z, t intervals using each fitted residual SD; conditional means at fixed z
bayesian_likelihood: independent Normal(y | alpha+beta*x+gamma*z, sigma=8 score points), with sigma fixed as a transparent working assumption

primary_prior.parameterization: independent Normal(mean, SD), score points except beta points per reported hour

sensitivity.note: a skeptical prior and a likelihood-scale stress test, not post-data defaults

posterior: exact multivariate Normal under fixed residual sigma, no MCMC
posterior_predictive_discrepancy: number of absolute residuals exceeding 16 score points at fitted conditional mean; replicated expected count integrates posterior coefficient uncertainty and fixed sigma
prior_predictive_stress: probability score falls outside 0 to 100 at hours 5/z=0 and hours 6.5/z=1 under the prior predictive Normal working model
population_scope: 72 fictional volunteers only; no probability sample or experimental hours assignment
